Clinical outcomes for acute surgery patients in [[Danmark]] are rigorously monitored through the [[Akut Kirurgi Databasen]], focusing primarily on mortality rates at 30 and 90 days post-operation or hospital arrival. These outcomes are evaluated using specific quality indicators, notably [[Indikator 9]], [[Indikator 9b]], [[Indikator 9c]], and [[Indikator 10]], which stratify patient risk using the Charlson Comorbidity Index to ensure fair comparisons across different patient populations.

Nationally, the 90-day mortality rate ([[Indikator 10]]) for the period between September 1, 2023, and August 31, 2024, was 16.6% (95% CI: 15.4–18.0), corresponding to 529 deaths out of 3,179 recorded treatment courses [^src1]. When measuring 30-day mortality from hospital arrival ([[Indikator 9]]), the national rate was 11.8% (95% CI: 10.7-13.0), with 376 deaths among the same 3,179 patients [^src4]. 

Patient comorbidities significantly influence these clinical outcomes. For patients with a [[Charlson Score = 0]], the 30-day post-operative mortality rate was 6.2% (95% CI: 5.0-7.6) among 1,324 analyzed patients [^src2]. For those with a [[charlson-score-1-2]], the national 30-day mortality rate was 12.5% (143 deaths out of 1,144 patients) [^src2]. Detailed regional and hospital-level breakdowns for [[Indikator 9b]] (Charlson Score 1-2) and [[Indikator 9c]] (Charlson Score ≥ 3) reveal substantial variations in 30-day mortality across the country. For instance, in [[Midtjylland Region i alt]], 40 out of 152 patients with a Charlson Score of 1 or 2 died within 30 days [^src3], while [[Aarhus Universitetshospital]] recorded 10 deaths out of 37 patients in the same cohort [^src3]. Similar granular data is available for [[Nordjylland Region i alt]], [[Aalborg Universitetshospital]], [[Regionshospital Nordjylland]], [[Odense Universitetshospital - Svendborg]], [[Sygehus Lillebælt]], [[Sygehus Sønderjylland]], [[Esbjerg Sygehus Grindsted Sygehus]], [[Hospitalsenhed Midt]], [[Regionshospitalet Gødstrup]], [[Regionshospitalet Horsens]], and [[Regionshospitalet Randers]], highlighting the comprehensive nature of the database in monitoring acute surgical outcomes across all Danish regions [^src3].

## Claims

### AKDB_2024.pdf, pages 51-55
- Nationalt var andelen af patienter, der døde indenfor 90 dage fra operationsdato, 16,6 % (95 % CI: 15,4–18,0) i perioden 01.09.2023 – 31.08.2024 [^src1] (indikator-10, danmark)
- For Indikator 10 var antallet af døde patienter 529 ud af 3.179 forløb på nationalt plan [^src1] (indikator-10, danmark)

### AKDB_2024.pdf, pages 61-65
- Der indgik 1.324 patienter i indikatoranalysen i perioden. Heraf døde 6,2 % (95 % CI: 5,0-7,6) indenfor 30 dage fra operation [^src1] (akut-kirurgi-databasen, charlson-score-0)
- Danmark: 143 / 1.144 patienter døde indenfor 30 dage efter akut kirurgi ved Charlson Score = 1 eller 2, svarende til 12,5 % (95 % CI: 10,6-14,6) [^src1] (danmark, charlson-score-1-2)
